title: Pinata Antiguo del Fantasma! IV
description: Pinata Antiguo del Fantasma! IV — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: QuestGiver_D

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill the Pinata Antiguo del Fantasma and the 3 Heroes in the Pinata Standoff that randomly appears off of Level 6 of Ratsputin's Gulag. Then return to the Scared Lass in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: QuestGiver_D

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Kill the Pinata Antiguo del Fantasma and the 3 Heroes in the Pinata Standoff that randomly appears off of Level 6 of Ratsputin's Gulag. Then return to the Scared Lass in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

Ok, I think it might actually be the evil monsters in the Pinata Standoff off of Level 6 of Ratsputin's Gulag that are scaring me. At this point I'm not really using any sort of logic to come up with these ideas. It's actually a method I like to call Scareography. I get out a map of the dungeon and close my eyes and the first spot I point to is where the scary must be coming from.

Go to the entrance to the Pinata Invitational off of Level 6 of Ratsputin's Gulag and it might magically take you to the Pinata Showdown. If it does kill the three evil Heroes and the evil pinata spirit, Pinata Antiguo del Fantasma. When you have done this return to me, the Scared Lass, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Turn-in:

I am still too afraid to sleep! Woe is me.... You know, what is fear anyway? Maybe it is just all in my imagination. Here, I'll close my eyes and tell myself that fear isn't rea... OH MY GOSH! Fear is real! It is sooooo real! Please try again!

Objectives:

  • Destroy the Pinata Antiguo del Fantasma on Level 6
  • Destroy the Three Evil Heroes on Level 6

Client level range: 90–100
